appearance: Separate service-courtyard shed with two courses of white vertical boards, green single-slope sheet roof, stone sill and recessed high-end louver panel.
dimensions: Photo-based exterior estimate. Body 4.6 by 3.7 m. Wall heights rise from 1.86 to 2.95 m. The high-end louver, shallow overhang and stone sill follow the two courtyard views.
limitations: Location and orientation come from an approximate photo reconstruction with partially obscured aerial context. The footprint, panels and heights are exterior estimates. The museum names the three courtyard buildings as a group. The assignment of this boarded building as the woodshed follows the contrasting kitchen and icehouse in the tour.
The interior, concealed rear details and exact terrain levels are approximate.

panoramas.observations: Continuous long wall with white vertical boarding, upper rail and green metal shed roof.
High short side exposes a recessed slatted panel. Grey gabled outbuilding and hipped kitchen remain independent.
